ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Via VMware Xfer
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects loading of a DLL by the VMware Xfer utility from the non-default directory which may be an attempt to sideload arbitrary DLL Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\VMwareXferlogs\\\.exe$") AND ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\glib\\-2\\\.0\\\.dll$")) AND  NOT (ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\VMware\\\\"))
